⚔️ EMPYRM WEAPONS PLUGIN ⚔️

Empyrm Weapons introduces powerful divine weapons inspired by Greek mythology, created exclusively for the Empyrm SMP — a scripted Minecraft server built around gods, kingdoms, and corruption.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🏛️ What is Empyrm SMP?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Empyrm SMP is a story-driven Minecraft server heavily based on Greek mythology. 
Players experience scripted events, evolving lore, and divine conflicts shaped by the gods themselves.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
👑 Kingdom Weapons
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Weapons blessed by Olympian gods and wielded by champions of the kingdoms.

⚡ Axe — Zeus
Harness the power of thunder and overwhelming strength.

💀 Sword — Hades
A weapon connected to death and the Underworld.

🔥 Mace — Hephaestus
Forged in divine fire by the god of the forge.

⚔️ Spear — Ares
Built for warfare and aggressive combat.

🏹 Bow — Artemis
Precision, speed, and deadly accuracy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
☠️ Corrupted Weapons
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Relics born from primordial darkness.

🔱 Trident — Erebus
A corrupted weapon tied to shadow and chaos.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ Features
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Custom OP mythological weapons
• Greek mythology inspired lore
• Designed for scripted SMP storytelling
• Perfect for events and progression systems
• Expandable weapon system for future gods

Note:
Weapon names are placeholders and will evolve with server lore.


```
Commands
/kingdomweapon list or /kw list - shows all configured weapons.
/kingdomweapon give <weapon> [player] or /kw give <weapon> [player] - gives a custom weapon.
/kingdomweapon reload or /kw reload - reloads config.yml.
```
